name: Camping 101: Mining
summary: You can now make a Lodestone and prepare to camp in the wilderness.

sections.title: A Place to Camp
sections.body: You can now craft your own Lodestone. Try it in the wilderness, where folk are less likely to mind a camp. Before you start, you will also need a campfire. A cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: From now on you can craft a Lodestone yourself.

faq.q: Where should I try the Lodestone?
faq.answer: Head into the wilderness to try it; most folk do not want camps in the center of town.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before starting your camp.

faq.q: Who can teach me to make a campfire?
faq.answer: A cook can teach you to make a campfire.
